title: Shop profile (public part)
description: What differs between shops and is safe for anyone to read. Hosting serves it as /shop-profile.js; the shop and the stockroom read it when the page opens. Plan, test mode, Stripe account and sender domain are NOT here: they live in server-only documents and the platform registry.

version.description: Format version. Bump only with a change both apps can read.

shopId.description: The shop's id in the registry, also the project id suffix.

firebase.description: The Firebase web settings. Not secret.

siteUrl.description: The shop's address, no trailing slash.

appCheckSiteKey.description: Bot-protection site key. Empty or missing: the app's build setting is used.
